candidates.change_summary: Remove the totalSupply decrement from burn so totalSupply is unchanged after burn.
Add an extra totalSupply decrement in burn so totalSupply decreases by twice _value.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from burn so anyone can call it, changing totalSupply.
Invert the onlyOwner check so only non-owners can call burn, changing totalSupply behavior.
Delete the totalSupply decrement, so burning reduces the owner's balance without reducing totalSupply.
Remove the require in the onlyOwner modifier, making burn callable by anyone.
Delete the require check on the owner's balance, allowing burn to underflow the balance.
Delete the balanceOf decrement, so only totalSupply is reduced but the owner's balance stays unchanged.
Change the balanceOf decrement to increment, increasing the owner's balance on burn.
Change the totalSupply decrement to increment, increasing totalSupply on burn.
